notes.title: [Post-Launch Patch] Minor Bugfix
notes.notes:
A very minor bugfix.

Changes:

 - Fixed  a display issue where the coins were not marked as obtained in the checkpoints list. The bug was only seen in checkpoint 5, space realm.


As always, please let me know if you encounter bugs or have feedback in Discord, Steam Community Discussions, or any other of the contacts below.

notes.title: [Post-Launch Patch] Bug Fixes & Improvements
notes.notes:
Camera & Controls:


     Mouse sensitivity scaling adjusted – The camera is now more responsive by default. Players may need to readjust their sensitivity settings.
     Camera jitter fix (Attempt 2) – Refined camera programming to reduce stuttering.
     Controller recommended – For the best experience, we suggest using a controller. The Steam page has been updated to reflect this.


Tutorial & UI:


     Fixed text overlay bug – Tutorial messages now display correctly.


Level Fixes:


     Recovered missing coins – Two coins in Space Realm, Checkpoint 5 have been returned to their proper places.


A Big Thanks!

These fixes were made possible thanks to your reports. If you spot any other issues, please let me know via Steam Community Discussions, Discord, or any of the other contact channels.

notes.title: [Post-Launch Patch] QOL Improvements and New DEMO Features
notes.notes:
Based on player feedback (thanks Ty), I have made some changes to the demo and the full game. Here they are:


 tutorial text/color changes
 main screen color changes
 guide renamed to control guide
 padding added in guide screen after gamepad to add gap between text
 added ability to control camera zoom via mouse wheel
 camera controls synchronized to framerate to address jitter issue. Note: camera sensitivity settings may need to be changed.


Full Game Only Changes:

 added copyright notice to start video for NINES and Unreal Engine


Demo Only Changes:

 all colors added to show how it changes (note: the color changes in the demo are representative only)
 themes reworded to realms for consistent terminology
 fixed mouse disappearing in the buy now screen. Also improved mouse behavior when the screen is exited.
 added a secret checkpoint which unlocks once the players collect all 12 coins
 added an unlockable accessory which can be obtain after collecting the additional 3 coins in the secret checkpoint


If you have any feedback, please feel free to reach out via any of the communication channels or the community forum.

Have fun!
